product.name: Climaflex Polyethylene Pipe Insulation 1m Lengths
product.description: Climaflex is a flexible polyethylene foam based closed cell pipe insulation suitable for a broad range of water and heating applications, frost protection and impact protection. It can be glued, taped or simply pushed together to form an insulated pipe, making it a convenient, versatile option. Available in 1mtr segments and multiple pipe sizes, Climaflex pipe insulation combines high performance and low cost in most domestic applications, giving you the best of both worlds. While you can also use it externally, keep in mind that it will degrade faster in sunlight.What’s more, Climaflex pipe insulation is a sustainable, environmentally friendly solution that is completely CFC (chlorofluorocarbon) and HCFC (hydrochlorofluorocarbon) free and has an ODP (ozone depletion potential) of zero. It can accommodate temperatures ranging from -45 °C to +105 °C and has excellent thermal conductivity. product.name: Honeywell Home V4073A Motorised Mid Position Diverter Valve
product.description:
The V4073A Valve has been designed to control the flow of water in domestic central heating systems, where both radiator and hot water cylinder circuits are pumped. It is typically suited for small to medium sized installations. The Mid-position Diverter Valve should be used in conjunction with a room thermostat and cylinder thermostat to provide full temperature control of a conventional, fully pumped central heating installation. When used in this way, the control system is known as Sundial Y Plan and the components can be connected together using the Sundial Plan Wiring Centre which has dedicated terminations and there is no need for a wiring diagram.

An alternative method of wiring is to use the Honeywell 10-way Junction Box (42002116-002) together with the Honeywell Sundial Plans Wiring Booklet.Features & Benefits: Honeywell Home V4073A Motorised Mid Position Diverter ValveSpring return actionThree position operationPowerhead replaceable without draining downManual lever for filling/draining downQuiet operation, minimal power consumptionProvides electrical output to boiler and/or pump

product.name: Spirotech SpiroCombi MB3 Magnetic Air and Dirt Separator
product.description: This SpiroCombi MB3 Magnetic Air Dirt Separator provides a solution for untreated systems where air may cause issues such as flow interruptions or even a complete system breakdown. Specially designed for the simultaneous removal of air and dirt, this SpiroCombi separator removes air, microbubbles and dirt particles from system water continuously. Separating the dirt that mainly consists of magnetite that accumulates wherever a magnetic field is present, this SpiroCombi separator is suitable for valves, heat exchangers, pipes, radiators, pumps and calorimeters. Reducing the costs associated with repairs, parts and downtime, this SpiroCombi separator minimises contamination which if untreated, leads to reduced system performance and therefore higher energy costs without any shut-off valves or bypass required. Features & Benefits: Spirotech SpiroCombi MB3 Magnetic Air and Dirt SeparatorRemoves circulating air and micro bubbles effectivelyVery small particles from 0.005mm are separated and removedDirt can be discharge while the system is in operationNo shut-off valves or bypass requiredConstant low-pressure dropExceptional guarantee

product.name: Altecnic Reflex Horizontal Expansion Vessels for Potable Water
product.description: This Reflex horizontal expansion vessel is for potable water. Closed hot water circuits cannot compress water, so any rise in volume from temperature changes needs to be accommodated by an expansion vessel. When water is cold, the pre-charge pressure makes the bladder collapse until the pump starts up as the bladder inflates. The system temperature increases due to the associated increase in pressure and volume, in turn allowing expanded water to enter the bladder adding volume and lowering pressure. product.name: Altecnic Reflex Expansion Vessel For Heating System - 8l up to 800l
product.description: The Reflex nitrogen-filled heating expansion vessel range by Altecnic is suitable for use with most heating or cooling systems. The vessels are manufactured to strict PED 97/23/EC Directive and BS EN 13831:2007 'Closed expansion vessels with built in diaphragm for installation in water' standards and tested according to the Pressure Systems Directive. They're available in a wide range of sizes, from 8 litres to more than 800 litres, making them a versatile, convenient solution. The vessels are made by welding the sections together, resulting in a sturdy, reliable structure suitable for internal pressures up to 3 bar for smaller sizes and 6 bar for larger sizes as well as flow temperatures of up to 120°C. They feature a non-replaceable diaphragm and grey-coated epoxy.But that's not all! Reflex vessels have low glass permeability and are resistant to ethylene or propylene glycol mixtures. In addition, there are many benefits to using nitrogen in the vessels. To begin with, nitrogen improves the vessel life span by reducing corrosion inside the vessel and prevents loss of pre-charge pressure. It also permeates through rubber slower than oxygen and is far less reactive to both steel and aluminium, creating fewer debris inside the vessel. Last but not least, nitrogen does not degrade rubber, prolonging the membrane life.Features & Benefits: Altecnic Reflex Expansion Vessel For Heating System - 8l up to 800lDurable nitrogen-filled heating expansion vessels  Consist of a carbon steel shell with carbon steel connections and synthetic rubber diaphragm  Powder Epoxy coating  1.5 bar factory pre-charge  Available in 8l to 800l+ sizes  Maximum vessel temp of 70°CPlease note: 800l+ capacity available, please call for more info.

product.name: Altecnic Reflex Mini Expansion Vessels for Potable Water
product.description: This Reflex horizontal expansion vessel is for potable water. Closed hot water circuits cannot compress water, so any rise in volume from temperature changes needs to be accommodated by an expansion vessel. When water is cold, the pre-charge pressure makes the bladder collapse until the pump starts up as the bladder inflates. The system temperature increases due to the associated increase in pressure and volume, in turn allowing expanded water to enter the bladder adding volume and lowering pressure. product.name: Altecnic Pressure Reducing Valve
product.description: The Series 535 range of high performance dial-up pressure reducing valves from Altecnic is designed for hot and cold systems in semi-commercial and industrial applications. They’re pre-adjustable, so you can set them at a required discharge pressure between 1 and 6 bar before installation with the help of the adjustment knob with pressure setting indicator. For greater convenience, the internal cartridge and control knob mechanism come assembled as one unit, making it easy to remove for inspection, cleaning and maintenance. Thanks to the compensated seat design of these pressure reducing valves, the set downstream pressure is independent of upstream pressure variations. In addition, the hydraulic profile makes it entirely possible to achieve low pressure losses even when a large number of outlets are open. The control stem housing of the cartridge consists of a highly adhesion-resistant plastic material, which helps prevent the formation of scale deposits forming. Available in multiple sizes, these valves operate at a maximum inlet pressure of 25 bar at a maximum temperature of 40C°. Features & Benefits: Altecnic Pressure Reducing ValveHigh performance DZR brass pressure reducing valves  Suitable for semi-commercial and industrial applications  Easy to install, clean and maintain  Outlet adjustment range of 1 - 6 bar  Maximum inlet pressure of 25 bar  WRAS approved

product.name: Baxi Buffer Vessel
product.description: The Baxi Buffer Vessel is a compact thermal storage unit designed to stabilise and optimise the performance of modern heating systems, particularly those using heat pumps. With a 24L or 40L capacity, it stores excess heat and releases it gradually as demand changes, helping to maintain steady system temperatures. By preventing frequent on/off cycling, it supports improved energy efficiency, smoother operation and longer heat pump lifespan.Built for practicality, the vessel includes multiple sensor pockets for easy integration and a built-in thermometer for straightforward system monitoring. Its compact, easy-install design makes it ideal where additional system volume is required to enhance heat pump performance. With no moving parts, it offers long-lasting reliability and minimal maintenance needs.Features & Benefits: Baxi Buffer Vessel24L or 40L capacity stabilises system temperatureBuilt-in thermometer and sensor pocketsEnhances efficiency with no maintenance required

product.name: MDPE Blue Pipe Coil Main Water Supply
product.description:
Manufactured from long-lasting, corrosion-free MDPE, otherwise known as alkathene, this range of pipe coils is ideal for below-ground distribution of potable water. Flexible, lightweight and straightforward to install, they are fully compatible with a wide range of push-fit fittings.
Suitable for use in pipeline rehabilitation installations, this MDPE pipe can also be utilised for open-cut and no-dig applications. With a 2.3mm thick solid wall, it features a colour-coded PE80 light blue exterior and PE80 black inner layer.

Standards & CertificationBSI approved (Kitemarked) to BS EN 12201-2-2011 + A1-2013Regulation 31 of the Water Supply (Water Quality) Regulations 2000: Approved
Please note: For above-ground water distributions, use black HDPE instead of blue MDPE.If BS 6572 is specified, use BS EN 12201 pipework.

This Armaflex pipe insulation comes in 2m lengths however a range of pipe sizes and wall thicknesses are offered to get the best system for you.

product.name: Geberit Mapress Copper 90 Degree Gas Elbow
product.description: The Gerberit 'Mapress' system of fittings is a versatile, reliable, and time-saving solution for a wide variety of gas plumbing applications, including natural and liquefied gases. Combining easy installation, secure fitting, and impressive longevity, the Mapress system of fittings is a compelling and cost-effective alternative to traditional, time-consuming soldering.These copper gas 90° elbows integrate seamlessly and easily into the Mapress line and are case-in-point for the time-saving technology on show with the system. product.name: Geberit Mapress Copper Slip Coupling
product.description: The Geberit 'Mapress' system of fittings is a versatile, reliable, and time-saving solution for all sorts of plumbing applications. Combining easy installation, secure seals, and impressive longevity, the Mapress system is a compelling alternative to arduous hot works and traditional soldering.These copper slip couplings are part of the core system and are case-in-point for the time-saving technology on show with the Mapress line. The pressing procedure for these couplings is around twice as fast as soldering, with no open flames required, using cold deformation of both the fitting and the pipe itself. Each slip coupling has clear pressing indicators for fuss-free installation with your tools, with a huge variety of fittings available too. product.name: Geberit Mapress Carbon Steel 90 Degree Elbow
product.description: The Gerbit 'Mapress' system of carbon steel pipes and fittings is a versatile, reliable, and time-saving solution for a huge variety of plumbing applications, including water, compressed air, heating and cooling. This NABIC 500 high lift safety valve is designed primarily for use on unvented hot water heating systems, where a high capacity, emergency steam relief capability is required. All wetted parts are manufactured from dezincification resistance materials. 
Designed and tested to BS EN ISO 4126-1 and WRAS approved, this safety valve has a resilient PTFE seating design with a high degree of seat tightness. It has a locked and sealed pressure setting. Offering easy inspection and cleaning, this safety valve has a high discharge capacity and diaphragm-protected parts. Features & Benefits: Nabic 1 inch 500 High Lift Safety Valve Easy inspection and cleaningHigh discharge capacityResilient PTFE seating designDiaphragm protected partFor use on unvented hot water heating systemsPressure setting locked and sealedPadlock available (complies with M&E3)Available with Viton seat design

product.name: Ideal Evo S Commercial Natural Gas Boiler
product.description: This Evo S Commercial Boiler Natural Gas is manufactured by Ideal Commercial Boilers and available in multiple outputs. Blending innovative stainless steel heater exchange technology with easy maintenance thanks to release internal water and gas couplings, it has an amazing net efficiency of up to 108.9% net efficiency when fully condensing. The boiler can be installed either on the wall or into a prefabricated floor-mounted frame, with at least a low-loss header as part of the system.This boiler is very user-friendly, with a simple controls interface with a large backlit display including integrated sequence control. product.name: 2 Multiline Cascade Kits
product.description: These Multiline Cascade Kits from Ideal Commercial Boilers are designed to streamline the installation process for up to six Evomax 2 boilers in a cascade configuration, with a combined capacity of up to 600kW. These kits are available in both starter and extension packs, providing a convenient solution for connecting Evomax 2 boilers that are installed as part of an open flue system through a common flue header. This simplifies the overall system design and installation process by establishing a single point of connection for the flue.In order to ensure the safe operation of the system, non-return valves are integrated to prevent the backflow of combustion byproducts through any individual boiler that is not currently firing.
